about: The collecta of the formulary “Fourth Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who makest the minds of the faithful to be of one will, grant to Thy peoples to love what Thou commandest and to desire what Thou dost promise, that amid the changes of the world our hearts may be fixed where true joys are found. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
